name: firm-discovery-call-agenda
description: Drafts the short note you send before a discovery call, with the purpose, their agenda, your agenda, the time and the possible outcomes including "no fit", the attendees by role asked through your contact, and a plain consent line for any recording or notetaker. Use for "run firm-discovery-call-agenda", "write the agenda for the first call", "send an agenda before we meet", "who should join the discovery call", "how do I ask about recording", "my first calls drift", "agree the outcome before the call", part of the Claude for Consultants · Team in Claude Pack by 90n.
